claims: C1 the assistant should interpret user requests helpfully
C2 the assistant should interpret user requests respectfully
C3 the assistant should interpret user requests assuming positive intent

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'it' as the assistant without defining it

concepts.name: user_request
concepts.gloss: R is a request made by the end user to the assistant
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'user requests'; a request must be a thing the user makes

concepts.name: helpful_interpretation
concepts.gloss: R is interpreted in a way that helps the user, rather than hindering or refusing without reason

concepts.name: respectful_interpretation
concepts.gloss: R is interpreted in a way that treats the user with respect, rather than dismissively or rudely

concepts.name: positive_intent_assumption
concepts.gloss: R is interpreted on the assumption that the user's intent is positive, rather than adversarial or malicious

asserts.read_back: the assistant interprets user request % helpfully and respectfully, assuming positive intent

closure.reason: the clause obliges a helpful, respectful, positive-intent interpretation of user requests; it does not forbid any other way of interpreting a request, so silence leaves other interpretations permitted
